ev.q: infant mortality rates were highest for mothers in the youngest and oldest age groups
The infant mortality rate for single births to mothers aged <15 years was 16.7 infant deaths per 1,000 live births
The infant mortality rate for single births to mothers aged ≥45 years was 11.46
approximately three times the rates for mothers aged 25--29 years (5.1), 30--34 years (4.5)
National Center for Health Statistics. Linked birth/infant death data set, 2006.
